answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and claims one forge-milestone per epoch, forging an artifact violet-stamped with its own key after the epoch beacon flashes. Auditors replay it on the public log: a pre-flash artifact fails freshness, a rented one fails the key check, each forgery burning its bond. Forging 1,000 milestones costs 60,000 per epoch plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent forges one for 60 and keeps its bond.
